summary:
A single-storey Roman villa, 36 by 48 blocks, built around three open courts: a street front with a recessed fauces between four shuttered shops, an atrium roofed in a ring with a square compluvium over an impluvium, and a peristyle garden court ringed by a white quartz colonnade, with the tablinum on the axis between them.
Roofs are red-tile shed bands that slope inward to the courts, leaving the compluvium open; the walls are cream plaster with a red dado over mosaic floors.
Five parts (shell, roofs, peristyle, atrium, facade) build the shell and the courts, then 18 room designers furnish the interiors in parallel.

shell: parts/shell.mjs builds the plinth, y1 mosaic/grass/socle floor, every wall run (plaster + dado, raised high sides), pocket, fauces door, four shop openings with shutters, atrium/tablinum/peristyle/triclinium doors, and the iron-bar windows. The shell line reports 5986 placed, no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE. build.nbt (36x10x52) is in place from a manual build; check shows 0 floating and 0 unsupported blocks, and the front and oblique renders read as a walled villa.
Added walls at z=14, z=28 and z=39 (x0..8 and x27..35) so the cubicula close, and recorded that in plan.md Notes.

The roofs part, or a stub gate in make.sh that also checks roofs.mjs, has to fix it. I ran build.mjs by hand and moved the result into build.nbt; make.sh itself was not edited because it is outside my module.
Pediment (E02) is not built: the pocket cells at y6 x16..19 and y7 x17..18 are carved to air for the roofs part.
Atrium red medallion (E17) is not built: the impluvium takes the centre. The tablinum 2x2 medallion is built.
Floor cells left as air at y1 for later parts: impluvium box, fountain box, bed cells (x13..14 and x21..22, z31..36), path legs (x17..18, z27..29 and z38..40).
Plan gap filled: cubicula walls at z=14, z=28 and z=39 (recorded in plan.md Notes); the y1 socle under walls is polished_andesite.

polish: E02 pediment not placed: quartz_stairs at y6 x16..19 and y7 x17..18 (z=0) are refused because the shell owns those air cells; needs the shell to leave them unowned, or the pediment moved into the shell part.

Ridges of the 9-deep bands (RA, RE, RG) want y9 but the pitch ladder's lowest step (0.5) rises to y10; the course above y9 is clipped (flat cap). Plan's y9 ridges need pitch ~1/3, which is a pitch bypass needing --why; not done.

make.sh's roof step (whole-building roof --dry-run) auto-detects the building as one roof and warns ROOF_TOO_TALL / ROOF_BIG_PLANE; these are about the whole building, not the per-band design. Per-band overhang is 0 (flush eaves), so no ROOF_NO_OVERHANG fix was attempted.

Roof tool quirk for the shared pipeline: roof() reads walls with raw coordinates but writes via SiteGrid.set (z+4), and it grows/shifts the grid when a cell lands at x<0, z<0 or beyond the size. Worked around in roofs.mjs with a scratch grid; documented in plan.md NOTES FROM THE ROOFS PART.

Fix in shell.mjs: write nothing at y1 on LATER_FLOOR cells (not even air). Not my module, so not edited.
